premises.text: Despite huge social networks, people make only about four valuable connections a year; existing networks reinforce known ties but do not discover hidden valuable people
premises.evidence_span: four is the number of valuable, on average, valuable connections being made in a given year

premises.text: iPhone app lets users select contacts, request permission, make, manage, and track introductions on the go
premises.evidence_span: Somazi's iPhone app allows you to make, manage, and track valuable introductions on the go

premises.text: Socializing Your Real-Time Needs web service broadcasts needs/opportunities across networks to leverage hidden networks of people you know, with dashboard analytics on reach and rebroadcasts
premises.evidence_span: Socializing Your Real-Time Needs is a web service that allows you to intelligently connect to the masses

value.text: Intelligently connect people to people and opportunities they do not know but should
value.evidence_span: connect intelligently to the people and opportunities that you don't know, but should

causal_links.evidence_span: they're not designed to actually discover hidden networks of the people that you should be connected with
strengthen your relationships on a one-on-one basis
connect intelligently with the people in your network and their networks and their network's network
